summary: Secure development environments for developers and their agents built with Go, supporting VSCode integration, Terraform infrastructure provisioning, and agent-based workflows.
usecases: Providing isolated, secure coding environments for development teams
Enabling agent-assisted development through integrated tooling
Managing consistent development setups via Terraform configurations
ideas: Integrate directly with popular IDEs like VSCode for seamless developer experience
Build automated CI/CD pipelines leveraging agent automation capabilities
Create reusable infrastructure-as-code templates for reproducible environments
